scope: Root-authored partner transaction validation, company self-service contract denial and newly approved existing-admin-verification gate. This worker owns only three reserved test files; no application edits, commits, deployment, providers or learning artifact.

findings.before: Invalid pagination was coerced/interpolated into SQL, invalid dates could raise500, and same-timestamp rows lacked a stable tie-breaker.
findings.after: Whole finite integer bounds are validated and parameterized; list/export share bounded string filters and real dates, with created_at/id deterministic ordering. Valid large limits remain capped.
findings.verification: Actual HTTP signed-partner requests reject 13 malformed bounds and eight list/export date cases with400 and no internal error logs. Two same-time own rows traverse exact stable page IDs; scoped export excludes wrong-status, wrong-date and foreign-partner rows.

findings.before: Plan endpoint could mark a plan active and insert a paid invoice without a payment or agreed contract change; cancellation could mutate the same contract subscription.
findings.after: Both legacy self-service billing writes deny403 with agreed-contract/Support guidance. No organization/subscription/invoice/wallet/ledger/payment-method/audit mutation occurs.
findings.verification: Both writes returned200 in the pre-fix HTTP run; after repair they return403 with complete before/after row snapshots identical.

findings.before: Company onboarding lacked an operational approval boundary and could create a14-day free period.
findings.after: Pending/unverified/rejected company operations deny403 until the existing organization admin-verification status is verified. Overview,billing,support,settings and notifications retain onboarding access. New signup persists pending/canceled company metadata, zero wallet and no trial/subscription or paid invoice. Session exposes organizationVerificationStatus.
findings.verification: Three workflow cases each prove21 denied operations with unchanged fleet/financial snapshots, allowed support/settings/notification follow-up that cannot self-approve, and actual DB verification transition restoring four reads and fuel-code issuance. Signed-session real signup proves pending/no subscription/no invoice and retained onboarding access.
findings.reproductionLimit: This new user-approved gate was already implemented when tests were added; no separate pre-gate red is claimed. Initial signup test fixture omitted required phone (400), then was corrected; not an application failure.

fixture: Explicit disposable loopback PostgreSQL database; unique per-file schemas cleaned after tests, synthetic records only. Existing storage boundary mocked/local delivery; no production/provider effects.
counts: Focused runs overlap one another and root full suites; do not sum5/23/63 into a project total.
limits: Existing verification_status is a product approval gate, not independent proof a legally valid contract was signed. Owner/admin operating procedure and qualified legal/financial/tenant human review remain release gates.
Company workflow fixture injects route user identity; signup/invitation file separately uses real signed durable sessions. Do not call injected-route assertions JWT verification evidence.
Current company shell banner/browser and final API/web/build/hosted approval review remain parent-owned.
